issue.description:
# CI failure: tests/contract_manifest.txt is stale (missing test_tool_adoption_report_tool.py)

## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection`

Deterministic, not a flake: the assertion text is `tests/contract_manifest.txt is stale; run
just refresh-contract-manifest`. The marker currently selects one more file than the committed
manifest: `tests/test_tool_adoption_report_tool.py`. That file was added by `9cfb06a54`
(`docs(tool): teach the named-tool workflow and add adoption report`, 2026-09-20), which did not
refresh the manifest.

Observed 2026-09-20 in workspace sase_32 at master `244442ee8` during `just test-scoped` (which
escalated to the full lane), then reproduced in isolation, and reproduced again with the
working tree's `src/` changes reverted to `HEAD` (they touch none of this).

Remedy: `just refresh-contract-manifest`, then confirm the test passes.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: the assertion says the manifest is stale and names the one file the marker selects that the manifest lacks; fails identically in isolation, in the full lane, and with the working tree's src reverted to HEAD.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced on a stashed-clean tree at master 86ff62c08: tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection still fails with the marker selecting tests/test_tool_adoption_report_tool.py while the committed manifest omits it. It also fails inside the scoped lane's full-suite escalation.

payload.entry: Fixed on master by the sase-135 land agent at 9a56fc1294. Root cause was a race between two fixes: 5023214dbf (sase-iu) deliberately admitted tests/test_tool_adoption_report_tool.py to tests/contract_manifest.txt and re-curated _MANIFEST_ENTRY_BUDGET 66 -> 67 with a documented rationale, and ~1h later epic commit 58f2de8f80 (sase-135.7) removed 'pytestmark = pytest.mark.contract' from that same test file without refreshing the manifest, which re-broke test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection in the opposite direction (manifest listed 67, marker selected 66). Resolution restores the contract marker, honoring sase-iu's curation decision: tools/tool_adoption_report is not an import-graph node, so RULE_CONTRACT_SET_ONLY fires and the contract set is that script's only scoped-selection coverage. Verified: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_contract_manifest.py -q -> 3 passed, and the full-escalated just test-scoped lane no longer reports this node.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced by the sase-zr.7 land agent on 2026-09-20 at master 598f1e820, in the full just test-scoped lane (43754 passed, 5 failed) and in isolation. Same node, same one-command remediation (just refresh-contract-manifest), but the staleness has FLIPPED DIRECTION and the bead's current description is now backwards: 5023214db admitted tests/test_tool_adoption_report_tool.py to the manifest, then 58f2de8f8 (feat(tool): make ToolRun output truncation explicit, SASE_BEAD=sase-135.7) deleted 'pytestmark = pytest.mark.contract' from that same file without refreshing the manifest. So the marker now selects 66 files while the committed manifest lists 67, and the assertion reads 'Right contains one more item'. Whoever fixes this must re-run the refresh at current master, not just confirm 5023214db landed; and the real gap is that nothing forces a manifest refresh when a contract marker is REMOVED.

Independently reproduced 2026-09-20 in workspace sase_19 at master e99bd48ac4 during just test-scoped, and again on a clean tree (my diff stashed): tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection fails with 'tests/contract_manifest.txt is stale'. The marker selects tests/test_validate_changelog_tool.py at index 57 where the committed manifest still lists tests/test_tool_adoption_report_tool.py, i.e. the manifest and the marker selection disagree on that entry. My change adds no @pytest.mark.contract test.

payload.entry: TRIAGE VERIFIED FIXED (2026-09-20, athena workspace sase_34, master ec7dbbfdf == origin/master): tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection passes (1 passed, 88s). Both sides now agree: tests/contract_manifest.txt line 58 lists tests/test_tool_adoption_report_tool.py and that file still carries 'pytestmark = pytest.mark.contract' (line 11), so the marker selection and the committed manifest match in the direction the sase-135 land agent restored at 9a56fc1294. Neither the original staleness nor the flipped-direction staleness the sase-zr.7.land +1 reported survives at this master. The +1 reporters' broader point -- that nothing forces a manifest refresh when a commit adds or removes pytest.mark.contract -- is a separate hardening idea, not this bead's failure, and is not tracked by this close.

payload.close_reason: Fixed on master; test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection passes at ec7dbbfdf
